summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: Package states 50000 hours; spec requires at least 50000 hr.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: Without DLC listing confirmation, we can’t verify eligibility for energy rebates or compliance with project sustainability goals.

findings.title: macadam steps
findings.detail: Package states 3; spec requires at most 3.

highlights.quote: LEDs are binned to a 3-step SDCM;

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Dims down to
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: If the light doesn’t dim smoothly to 5%, it may cause visual discomfort or fail to meet lighting control intent in corridors.

findings.title: Revision Date Difference Noted
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 10/25/17, web source 4/17/2025. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Just because the revision dates differ doesn’t mean one is newer—we need actual content comparison to know if anything changed.
